situations.title: 패혈증 조기 인지
situations.tagline: My husband suddenly seems so confused and his breathing is really fast — is something wrong?
situations.brief: qSOFA와 초기 징후를 스크리닝해 패혈증을 조기에 인지하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm checking his breathing rate, blood pressure, and how alert he is right now.
These signs help us catch infection early, so we're watching him closely.
I'll let the doctor know right away if anything changes.

situations.title: 젖산·혈액배양 채취
situations.tagline: Why are you taking so much blood before you even start the antibiotics?
situations.brief: 항생제 투여 전에 젖산과 혈액배양을 정확히 채취하세요.
keyPhrases: We draw these cultures before antibiotics so we can find the exact bug.
This lactate level tells us how your body is handling the infection.
It only takes a moment, and it helps us treat you the right way.

situations.title: 광범위 항생제 신속 투여
situations.tagline: The nurse said the first hour matters — are we still on time?
situations.brief: 1시간 번들에 맞춰 광범위 항생제를 신속히 투여하세요.
keyPhrases: We're giving broad antibiotics right now to cover the likely infection.
Starting them within the first hour gives the best chance of recovery.
The medication is running, and I'm timing it carefully.

situations.title: 초기 수액 소생 협조
situations.tagline: You're giving him a lot of fluid so fast — is that safe for his heart?
situations.brief: 30mL/kg 수액 소생의 반응을 확인하며 가족과 협조하세요.
keyPhrases: We're giving fluids to raise his blood pressure and improve circulation.
I'm watching his pressure and urine output to see how he responds.
If his lungs sound wet, we'll adjust the rate right away.

situations.title: 감염원 병력·부위 사정
situations.tagline: I've had a burning feeling when I pee for a few days — could that be it?
situations.brief: 감염원 추정을 위해 병력과 부위를 체계적으로 사정하세요.
keyPhrases: Can you tell me where you've had pain, redness, or a fever?
Any recent surgeries, catheters, or wounds can point us to the source.
Knowing where the infection started helps us treat it precisely.

situations.title: 활력·관류 재평가
situations.tagline: Is he doing any better after all that fluid and medicine?
situations.brief: 소생 반응을 확인하기 위해 활력징후와 관류를 재평가하세요.
keyPhrases: I'm rechecking his blood pressure, heart rate, and how warm his skin is.
Better urine output and clearer thinking are good signs he's responding.
We'll keep reassessing to make sure he's moving in the right direction.

situations.title: 패혈성 쇼크 승압 시작
situations.tagline: His pressure isn't coming up even with all the fluid — what happens now?
situations.brief: 수액 불응을 판단하고 승압제 시작을 안전하게 준비하세요.
keyPhrases: His blood pressure isn't responding to fluids alone, so we're adding a medication.
This drip helps tighten the blood vessels and support his pressure.
We'll give it through a central line and watch him very closely.

situations.title: 젖산 클리어런스 재평가
situations.tagline: You keep checking that lactate number — what does it actually tell you?
situations.brief: 소생 목표에 따라 젖산 클리어런스를 재평가하세요.
keyPhrases: A falling lactate tells us his circulation is improving with treatment.
We recheck it to make sure the resuscitation is working.
If it stays high, we may need to do more to support him.
goals: 목표 미달 시 추가 조치를 연계한다

situations.title: 감염원 제거 조율
situations.tagline: They said he might need a drain — why can't the antibiotics just fix it?
situations.brief: 배액과 감염원 제거를 위해 관련 팀과 협조하세요.
keyPhrases: Antibiotics work best when we also remove the source of infection.
The team is planning to drain the infected fluid to help him recover.
I'll coordinate with the procedure team and keep you updated.

situations.title: 항생제 스튜어드십·조정
situations.tagline: The culture came back — does that mean you're changing his antibiotics?
situations.brief: 배양 결과를 반영해 항생제를 적정 조정하세요.
keyPhrases: The culture shows the exact bacteria, so we can narrow the antibiotic.
Using a more targeted drug reduces side effects and resistance.
The team is adjusting his treatment based on these results.

situations.title: 스테로이드 보조 판단
situations.tagline: His pressure still needs those drips — are you adding a steroid now?
situations.brief: 승압 불응 상황에서 스테로이드 보조 요법을 판단하세요.
keyPhrases: His pressure still needs high vasopressor support despite fluids.
We're considering low-dose steroids to help stabilize him.
Let's confirm the order and monitor his response closely.

situations.title: 장기부전 진행 모니터
situations.tagline: I'm seeing his kidney and liver numbers creeping up on the chart.
situations.brief: SOFA 추세를 추적해 장기부전 진행을 모니터하세요.
keyPhrases: His SOFA score is trending up, so organ function is worsening.
Let's flag the rising creatinine and bilirubin to the team.
Early recognition helps us escalate support in time.

situations.title: 수액 과부하 균형
situations.tagline: His legs are so swollen now — is all that fluid still helping him?
situations.brief: de-resuscitation 관점에서 수액 과부하 균형을 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Now that he's more stable, we're carefully removing extra fluid.
The swelling means his body is holding too much water.
We balance giving and removing fluid to protect his lungs and organs.

situations.title: 면역저하 패혈증 특수 관리
situations.tagline: My son is on chemo — does his low immunity make this infection more dangerous?
situations.brief: 중성구감소 등 면역저하 환자의 패혈증을 특수 관리하세요.
keyPhrases: Because his immune system is low, we treat any infection very aggressively.
We use extra precautions to protect him from new germs.
The team may start special antibiotics and support his blood counts.

situations.title: 다제내성 의심 경험적 확대
situations.tagline: You're switching to a stronger antibiotic — is his infection resistant?
situations.brief: MDRO 위험을 소통하며 경험적 항생제를 확대하세요.
keyPhrases: Because of his risk factors, we're broadening the antibiotic coverage.
This helps make sure we treat any resistant bacteria.
We'll narrow it down once the cultures guide us.

situations.title: 불응성 패혈성 쇼크 다중승압
situations.tagline: 환자는 다중 승압제에도 혈압이 유지되지 않아 대화가 불가능한 위중한 상태이다.
situations.brief: MODS를 인지하고 다중 승압 에스컬레이션을 신속히 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: He's on multiple pressors and still not maintaining his pressure.
We're seeing multi-organ dysfunction, so we need to escalate now.
Let's call the intensivist and prepare the next line of support.

situations.title: 패혈증 유발 DIC·출혈 위기
situations.tagline: 환자는 의식이 없고 여러 부위에서 출혈이 지속되어 응고와 수혈 대응이 시급하다.
situations.brief: 응고 이상을 인지하고 수혈과 함께 DIC 출혈 위기에 대응하세요.
keyPhrases: He's bleeding from multiple sites and his clotting labs are abnormal.
This looks like DIC, so we need blood products fast.
Let's send a DIC panel and get the massive transfusion protocol ready.

situations.title: 급성 호흡부전 ARDS 진행
situations.tagline: 환자는 산소포화도가 급격히 떨어지고 호흡부전이 진행되어 환기 에스컬레이션이 필요하다.
situations.brief: ARDS 진행을 인지하고 환기 에스컬레이션을 신속히 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: His oxygen is dropping fast despite high support.
This is progressing to ARDS, so we need to escalate ventilation.
Let's prepare for intubation and call respiratory therapy.

situations.title: 급성 신손상 CRRT 필요
situations.tagline: 환자는 무뇨와 대사 이상이 진행되어 신대체요법 연계가 시급한 상태이다.
situations.brief: 급성 신손상 악화를 인지하고 CRRT 연계를 신속히 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: He's making almost no urine and his potassium is climbing.
He needs continuous dialysis to control fluid and electrolytes.
Let's coordinate with the dialysis team to start CRRT.

situations.title: 괴사성 감염 응급 수술 조율
situations.tagline: 환자는 괴사성 연조직 감염이 급속히 번져 시급한 source control 수술이 필요하다.
situations.brief: 시급한 source control을 위해 응급 수술을 신속히 조율하세요.
keyPhrases: The infection is spreading fast and the tissue is dying.
He needs emergency surgery to remove the source right away.
Let's alert the OR team and prep him immediately.

situations.title: 다장기부전 목표 재설정
situations.tagline: The doctors said his organs are failing — I need to understand what our options really are.
situations.brief: 예후를 바탕으로 가족과 치료 목표를 재설정하며 소통하세요.
keyPhrases: His organs are struggling despite everything we're doing.
I want to make sure we understand what matters most to him.
The team can help you weigh the options with care and honesty.
